description: React + axios frontend against a FastAPI backend, with five cross-layer API contract defects. Every layer parses and type-checks on its own; only the seams are wrong.

findings.title: Frontend calls an endpoint the backend does not define
Frontend request path does not match any backend route (likely typo)
findings.note: Differs from a real route by one character; the engine should suggest the near match rather than only reporting it missing.

findings.title: HTTP method mismatch between frontend call and backend route
Request body field names do not match the backend schema
findings.note: camelCase/snake_case drift. The engine must not flag this where an alias or a serialiser config reconciles the two.

findings.title: Call to an authenticated route sends no credentials
findings.expected: An Authorization header, since the route depends on require_admin
findings.actual: No Authorization header is set on the request or the axios client

must_not_report.reason: listUsers, listTasks and createTask are correct on both sides and must not produce findings.
CORS is restricted to the dev origin, not a wildcard.
